name: ESP32 BLE Scanner
chip_detected: ESP32-D0WD-V3, revision 3.1 (recorded during prior board bring-up)
difficulty_reason: Uses the BLE scan API and serial output; no external circuit or third-party library is required.

validation.serial_output_note: Replacement/gibberish characters appeared around a firmware/boot transition in the pasted capture. Subsequent post-startup scan tables were readable in the supplied screenshot and log; cause of the earlier characters was not established.
validation.privacy: Raw nearby BLE device names and addresses are omitted from public evidence.
validation.evidence: User-provided Arduino IDE screenshot and repeated BLE scan output from physical hardware. Device identifiers were not retained in this metadata.

limitations: BLE advertisements only; not Bluetooth Classic discovery.
Only data present in advertisements is reported; a full GATT service inventory is not performed.
Connectability is an advertised indication, not a successful connection test.
Scan result record count is not a guaranteed count of unique physical devices.
